spark.scene: True-color view of the main Hawaiian Islands with the large island in the southeast and smaller islands extending northwest. Scattered to broken white cumulus and cirrus clouds cover parts of the islands and ocean, especially in the north and south, with large areas of dark open ocean visible in the northeast and central region. The summits of the large island are largely obscured by bright white orographic clouds, and no distinct gray or brown non-cloud haze or streak separate from ordinary clouds is clearly visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: The Halema'uma'u eruption of Kīlauea is currently paused after episode 55 fountaining ended on October 17. Summit reinflation has plateaued over the last 24 hours pushing the forecast for episode 56 fountaining to between Oct. 31 and Nov.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
